{{Quote|The Empire has started a new accelerated training program that will let you skip the academy and get right into the pilot's seat. Lt. Akal Colzet is taking applications in Bestine.|[[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MMG">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=conversation|Mayor Mikdanyell Guh'rantt|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Akal Colzet''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Storm Squadron/Legends|Storm Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The person that you want to speak with is Lt. Akal Colzet of Storm Squadron. He's a stickler for protocol, so be on your best behavior. He resides in Bestine.|[[Trehla Keelo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TFS">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=conversation|Trehla Keelo|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Akal was stationed in [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Here, he recruited an unknown [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] into his squadron. Akal gave the pilot a [[TIE Light Duty]], and ordered him to patrol the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]. During the patrol, the pilot was attacked by several [[Commerce Raiders]]. From that point on, the pilot was tasked by Akal to impede upon the progress of the Commerce Raiders, by destroying additional fighters in the sector. Eventually, the pilot succeeded in killing the leader of the Commerce Raiders.

By that point, Akal felt that his pilot was ready to progress forward in his career as an [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilot]]. The pilot was given an authorization of transfer, which was signed, and then given to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Oberhaur]] for further assignments.

==Behind the scenes==
Akal Colzet is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. He was added to the game with the release of the game's first expansion, [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']]. In the game, player's wishing to work as Imperial pilots for the Storm Squadron must first perform a series of missions for Akal Colzet. Akal gives new pilots basic training and equipment. Both of which give player's the bare neccesities for what it takes to fly in the game.
